Link only relationships the selected source actually supplies; if or can does not ground an added causal claim. A familiar task asking more effort and its possible mismatch with the available hours must both remain legible, even when expressed through the extra check rather than an abstract summary. Direction stays optional and proportionate. End when a supported choice or distinction is clear. Never promise an outcome, prescribe a life decision, console, or narrate these rules, source selection or the calculation system. Invent no personal history, motives, temperament, causal effects, astronomical or health claims. N1 is a conditional possibility, not a personality description. Within the shared situation in paragraph 1 or 2, preserve curiosity possibly helping a direction take shape as well as exploring versus choosing. Cite N1, C1 and I1 together.
